svg.title: 4K Omarchy frame achieved; Real guest GPU reaches QEMU SDL; live virtio trace improves handoff intervals; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: Real NVIDIA Omarchy wallpaper, bar and application reach QEMU SDL. Two virtio trace runs and two UART baselines pass 300 handoffs, full pixels, input response and live cleanup. Median steady CPU handoff intervals improve from 43–44 ms to 16.6–16.7 ms; displayed cadence, physical input latency and near-native performance remain unverified. Device-loss, zero-buffer and input-response failures remain retained. Backend stages stay 4 of 8 and product gates stay 0 of 4. Updated October 21, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Real guest → QEMU SDL: four active 300-frame runs pass complete pixel audits
Live virtio trace: median CPU handoff 16.6–16.7 ms, versus 43–44 ms on UART
Next: verify displayed cadence and official input; retained failures remain open
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-21
Real guest GPU source: 3840×2160 · SDL backbuffer: 2560×1566 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
